newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Norilsk Nickel gas supply cut 31 pct over gas debt.
newsitem.headline: Norilsk Nickel gas supply cut 31 pct over gas debt.

text.p: Natural gas supplies to Norilsk Nickel's main production complex have been cut by nearly one third over unpaid gas debts, a senior gas official said on Thursday.

Viktor Kot, deputy chief executive of Norilskgazprom, the supplier to the combine, told Reuters by telephone from the Arctic city of Norilsk that supplies had been slashed to 11 million cubic metres a day from 16 million since Tuesday.

"We warned the government and the combine that if gas is not paid for, we would be forced to take extreme measures," Kot said, adding the cuts were designed to send a wake-up call to the plant and to the government about inter-enterprise debt.
The government has been pressing debtors to pay up to various state budgets.

Kot said the combine, the main plant of the Norilsk Nickel metals group, a major world producer of nickel, copper, cobalt and platinum group metals, could face further cuts in 10 days if arrears of an unspecified size were not paid. Kot said Norilskgazprom needed money because it owed 70 billion roubles, before fines, to local and regional budgets as of April. It also owed money to the federal budget.
Norilskgazprom faces the loss of licences from some of its main production fields if it does not pay its debts.
